name: 89166 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89166 (Las Vegas) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89166 (Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89166 (Las Vegas) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 33% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
